about: Vantage display catalog: what the page paints for each decided id. The snapshot answers ids; everything an offer IS (its grammar: who, plan, consideration, value, what ends the credit, stacking, dates) is content, published here and never to the engine. Edited here, by hand, as data. The beat documents under beats/ are the edited data for the engine; scripts/seed-vantage.mjs is a thin wrapper that re-anchors their windows and publishes them, and leaves this file alone because it carries no instant.

ctxIntent.note: Asserted by the buy-box toggle and labelled as asserted; it gates offers (failing closed) and never prices.
